decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe builds directly on the firm's tube and plastics expertise, and the external recognition confirms that the firm can interpret and exploit its value.
The single-U borehole heat exchanger is a core geothermal product line rooted in the firm's established polymer and pipe know-how, so the firm can absorb market feedback and refine it.
The probe surface technology is a multi-model line that draws on the firm's materials and process knowledge and supports its other geothermal probes, which makes it worth retaining.
The fire-protection steel profile system lies close to the firm's core steel profile competence and certification experience, so it fits the firm's existing knowledge base well.
Slim steel profiles are a natural extension of the firm's profile system expertise, and its integrated production allows continuous improvement.
The decorative surface system builds on the firm's established profile and surface treatment know-how, but as a more design-driven add-on it carries a slightly higher risk of rationalisation.
